mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates monetary policy accommodation that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing market strength (HOUST > 1600) and industrial production weakness (INDPRO < 100) indicates demand-supply imbalance where consumer demand outpaces supply, generating positive equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600 and INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising residential sales (RSAFS > 680000) signals sustained consumer confidence that drives equity market momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 680000 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months reflects labor market strength that supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) and unemployment rise (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals monetary easing response to economic weakness, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) relative to 12-month average indicates weak manufacturing activity that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 during post-recession recovery, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
